objective: Repair the missing Linux normal-child Canvas focus trace so the round-trip harness can safely complete text editing, then capture the pinned Obsidian C07.4 reference contract across Linux, macOS, and Windows on one exact SHA. source_findings.supported_cause: The normal Linux child removes OPENOBSIDIAN_CI_CANVAS_FOCUS_TRACE while readCanvasFocusSnapshot requires a covering per-frame trace; the consumed request frame recorded path focused=false and ID focused=true.

source_findings.bounded_candidate: Enable the existing focus trace only for Linux Canvas text-edit children, leaving warmup children explicitly untraced and other platforms unchanged.
source_findings.capture_dependency: The Linux Canvas text-edit/round-trip flow precedes C07.4 capture; the Linux R3.10 failure stopped before clipboard staging and C07.4.

implementation.status: implementation complete; whole-source and tracker reviews passed
changes: Enable OPENOBSIDIAN_CI_CANVAS_FOCUS_TRACE for Linux Canvas text-edit children; the expected-abort policy is retained, warmup children still clear the flag, and non-Linux children still clear it.

acceptance: Independent whole-source and tracker review approves the complete R3.11 scope before its single push; the implementation is complete and reviewed before CI starts.

For each normal Linux Canvas text-edit focus snapshot, a covering same-frame trace and paired target/sibling diagnostics are present. If the initial focus guard fails, only the existing bounded recovery may proceed; recovery must satisfy all existing freshness, event-free, target-focus, sibling-preservation, refresh, pointer, and control predicates. Incomplete focus evidence or recovery fails closed before clipboard staging, Ctrl+V, or save; trace availability alone does not authorize input.

Linux Canvas text edit, transaction/save, close/reopen, and vault/app-data preservation pass on the exact SHA. The expected-abort canary proves the synthetic target-value mismatch is its sole expected failed pre-motion predicate, performs no motion/paste/save, cleans request/clipboard markers, terminates cleanly, and preserves exact vault and app-data snapshots.

All ten C07.4 scenarios pass first-open, reopen, and comparable-pair predicates on Linux, macOS, and Windows for the same exact implementation SHA; each platform has a complete 28-checkpoint source matrix and the tie-seed-order predicate. The additional stable preselection enumeration is required on macOS reopen only.

The harness reseeds the exact C07.4 fixture before reopen and reports reopen_seed_hashes_match=true. Record first-open and reopen source hashes and changed bytes at each checkpoint. Pinned-app source rewrites are captured reference observations; do not require post-reopen files to remain equal to seed or treat rewrites as Rust preservation evidence.

C07.4 reports retain runner-default locale policy, source mutation observations and limitations, captured-reference-only status, and rust_parity_claimed=false; reference-app rewrites are not misreported as Rust preservation or parity.
